CREATE TABLE PROD_DW.CUSTOMER_360 AS (SELECT c.CUST_ID, c.CUST_NM, SUM(f.AMT) AS LTV FROM PROD_DW.CUSTOMER c LEFT JOIN PROD_DW.ORDER_FACT f ON f.CUST_ID = c.CUST_ID GROUP BY 1,2) WITH DATA
INSERT INTO PROD_DW.CUSTOMER_360_HIST SELECT * FROM PROD_DW.CUSTOMER_360
INSERT INTO PROD_DW.EXEC_DASHBOARD SELECT s.REGION_NM, SUM(s.AMT), AVG(r.UTILISATION) FROM PROD_DW.SALES_SUMMARY s JOIN PROD_DW.CREDIT_RISK r ON r.REGION_NM = s.REGION_NM GROUP BY 1
